name.ja: Figure-rise Standard BD ガンダムベース限定 ダイバーアヤメ[ガンダムベースカラー]&プチッガイセット
name.en: Figure-rise Standard BD Gundam Base Limited Diver Iris [Gundam Base Color] & Petit'gguy Set

description.en: From "Gundam Build Divers", Diver Ayame and Petit'g Guy are now available as a set in Gundam base limited colors!

description.ja: • 特徴的な「くノ一」アクションも再現可能。
description.en: • Characteristic "kunoichi" actions can also be reproduced.

description.ja: • 表情パーツは、マスク付きに加え素顔3種の計4種が付属。
description.en: • A total of 4 types of expression parts are included, including one with a mask and 3 types of real faces.

description.ja: • ディスプレイベースのほか、バストアップ展示用パーツも付属。
description.en: • In addition to the display base, bust-up display parts are also included.
